excerpt.zh: 我们开始过载[target.GetName]来播种宇宙风暴。
excerpt.en: We have begun supercharging [target.GetName] to seed a Cosmic Storm.

texts.zh: 我们开始过载[target.GetName]来播种宇宙风暴。
texts.en: We have begun oversaturating [target.GetName] to seed a Cosmic Storm.

texts.zh: 我们正操纵[target.GetName]的恒星风来播种辐射风暴。
texts.en: We are manipulating [target.GetName]'s stellar winds to seed a Radiant Storm.

texts.zh: 我们正在切断围绕在[target.GetName]周围的电场来播种电力风暴。
texts.en: We are severing the electron fields surrounding [target.GetName] to seed a Electric Storm.

texts.zh: 我们正在操纵环绕[target.GetName]的离子来播种磁力风暴。
texts.en: We are manipulating the ions surrounding [target.GetName] to seed a Magnetic Storm.

texts.zh: 我们正在扰动围绕[target.GetName]的分子来播种粒子风暴。
texts.en: We are agitating molecules around [target.GetName] to seed a Particle Storm.

texts.zh: 我们正在破坏[target.GetName]的重力场来播种重力风暴。
texts.en: We are destabilizing the gravity fields of [target.GetName] to seed a Gravity Storm.

texts.zh: 我们正在搅乱围绕[target.GetName]的天体星尘来播种星尘风暴。
texts.en: We are scrambling the celestial dust around [target.GetName] to seed a Stardust Storm.

texts.zh:
我们现在正在[target.solar_system.GetName]星系严阵以待，开始着手进行制造一场宇宙风暴的必要准备。

通过暂时过载[target.GetName]，我们就可以为播种出所想要的星际气象学反应提供必要条件。
texts.en:
We are now in position in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system and ready to begin the necessary preparations to generate a Cosmic Storm.

By temporarily supercharging [target.GetName], we can create the ideal conditions to seed the desired astrometeorological reaction.

texts.zh: 使用先进的能量操纵技术，我们可以用原材料使[target.GetName]过饱和来形成结构上更复杂的风暴。
texts.en: Using advanced energy manipulation methods, we could oversaturate [target.GetName] with raw materials to form a more structurally complex storm.

texts.zh: 这会是一笔时间成本不菲的投资，但其结果会是[owner.GetName]的巨大成就。在行动结束后，恒星本身将会恢复原状。
texts.en: This will be a time-consuming endeavor, but the end result will be a great achievement for [owner.GetName]. The star itself will remain entirely intact after the operation is complete.

texts.zh: 对[target.solar_system.GetName]星系中宇宙风暴的准备已经到了关键阶段，下一步行动需要高度专注以及更多资源投入，将通过操纵[target.GetName]的恒星风来形成辐射风暴。
texts.en: The preparations towards the Cosmic Storm in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system have reached a pivotal stage. The next actions require intense focus and new resource commitments to forge a Radiant Storm by manipulating the solar winds of [target.GetName]

texts.zh: 对[target.solar_system.GetName]星系中宇宙风暴的准备已经到了关键时刻，下一步行动非常关键，需要对这一项目做出更集中的资源承诺。
texts.en: The preparations towards the Cosmic Storm in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system have reached a critical juncture. The next actions are crucial, and require more focused resource commitments to the cause.

texts.zh: 对[target.solar_system.GetName]星系中宇宙风暴的准备已经到了关键阶段，[storm_researcher.GetName]的下一步行动需要高度专注以及更多资源投入，并将从[target.GetName]的膨胀状态受益。
texts.en: The preparations towards the Cosmic Storm in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system have reached a pivotal stage. The next actions of [storm_researcher.GetName] require intense focus and new resource commitments to take advantage of the bloated state of [target.GetName].

texts.zh: 对[target.solar_system.GetName]星系中宇宙风暴的准备已经到了关键时刻，[storm_researcher.GetName]的下一步行动非常关键，如果我们要从[target.GetName]的碰撞状态中获取优势，就需要对这一项目做出更集中的资源承诺。
texts.en: The preparations towards the Cosmic Storm in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system have reached a critical juncture. The next actions of [storm_researcher.GetName] are crucial, and require more focused resource commitments to the cause, if we are to properly take advantage of the bloated of state of [target.GetName].

texts.zh:
强化的[target.GetName]恒星风终于到达了关键质量。

一场辐射风暴正如弦上之箭，弹手可发。

驾驭宇宙风暴的力量是一项不小的壮举，我们长年的耕耘终于到达了收获的时候了。
texts.en:
The intensified solar winds of [target.GetName] have reached critical mass.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Radiant Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.

texts.zh:
[target.GetName]的磁场被成功地切割了下来。

一场电力风暴正如弦上之箭，弹手可发。

驾驭宇宙风暴的力量是一项不小的壮举，我们长年的耕耘终于到达了收获的时候了。
texts.en:
The electron fields of [target.GetName] have been fully severed.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Electric Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.

texts.zh:
[target.GetName]的离子被成功磁化了。

一场磁力风暴正如弦上之箭，弹手可发。

驾驭宇宙风暴的力量是一项不小的壮举，我们长年的耕耘终于到达了收获的时候了。
texts.en:
The ions of [target.GetName] have been successfully magnetized.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Magnetic Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.

texts.zh:
饱和化的[target.GetName]离子已经达到了爆发临界点。

一场粒子风暴正如弦上之箭，弹手可发。

驾驭宇宙风暴的力量是一项不小的壮举，我们长年的耕耘终于到达了收获的时候了。
texts.en:
The saturated particles of [target.GetName] have reached their breaking point.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Particle Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.

texts.zh:
[target.GetName]的重力场已经被完全去稳定化了。

一场重力风暴正如弦上之箭，弹手可发。

驾驭宇宙风暴的力量是一项不小的壮举，我们长年的耕耘终于到达了收获的时候了。
texts.en:
The gravitational field of [target.GetName] has been sufficiently destabilized.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Gravity Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.

texts.zh:
[target.GetName]的星尘已经被彻底扰乱了。

一场星尘风暴正如弦上之箭，弹手可发。

驾驭宇宙风暴的力量是一项不小的壮举，我们长年的耕耘终于到达了收获的时候了。
texts.en:
The stardust of [target.GetName] has been fully scrambled.

We are on the brink of unleashing a Stardust Storm.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
